system_name: He thong Diem danh Sinh vien UEH

threats.statement: Ke tan cong co the gia mao dinh danh giang vien de diem danh khong hop le.
Ke tan cong doc du lieu bang ma sinh vien tren duong truyen khong ma hoa.
Ke tan cong thay doi truc tiep du lieu diem so hoac trang thai diem danh trong CSDL.
Ke tan cong ngan chan sinh vien truy cap he thong diem danh bang cach nhan chim bang luu luong DoS.
Nguoi dung thong thuong co the thuc thi cac lenh quan tri vi thieu kiem tra phan quyen.
Kẻ tan cong gia mao yeu cau tu phia nguoi dung hop phap de thuc hien hanh vi CSRF.
He thong kh ghi lai nhat ky (audit log) khi co truy cap bat thuong vao co so du lieu.
Ro ri thong tin nhạy cảm cua sinh vien qua loi cau lenh SQL Injection tren ung dụng.
